data.name: Optimize.game-dvr-off.Explanation
data.value: Xbox Game Bar records the last minutes of play all the time, which slows games down. Screenshots still work.

data.name: Optimize.game-mode.Explanation
data.value: Windows gives priority to the game you are playing.

data.name: Optimize.startup-delay-off.Explanation
data.value: Removes the delay Windows adds before starting programs after you sign in.

data.name: Optimize.menu-delay.Explanation
data.value: Submenus open after 0.1 s instead of 0.4 s. Applies after you sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.transparency-off.Explanation
data.value: Saves a little graphics power and battery. The look becomes slightly plainer. May need you to sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.animations-off.Explanation
data.value: Windows open and minimize instantly. Applies after you sign in again.

data.name: Optimize.fast-startup-off.Explanation
data.value: Useful if updates or devices misbehave after a shutdown, or with dual boot. Startup becomes a few seconds slower.

data.name: Optimize.power-high.Explanation
data.value: The processor stays at full speed. On a laptop, the battery drains faster.

data.name: Optimize.power-balanced.Explanation
data.value: The setting recommended by Windows: speed when needed, savings the rest of the time.

data.name: Optimize.hibernate-off.Explanation
data.value: Frees a file as large as your memory on the system disk. Also turns off Fast Startup. Keep it on a laptop.

data.name: Optimize.Intro
data.value: Settings that speed up Windows. Each one can be undone from History.
